regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your kind favor of July 17th. I am sure Fr. Lambert acknowledged same befor. Leaving for a trip to see an invalid brother of mine in Baltimore. I took your letter along hoping to answer it as it deserves to be answered; but I find myself almost as busy on my "vacation as in the office in Detroit. However, before I leave here as expected right after dinner, I want to assure you of my appreciation and that I shall surely include Joseph O' Donnell in my poor prayers as well as yourself. Now it's time and for the present I'll say Goodbye and again
